widget.name: MxTechies Draggable
widget.description: Makes the content placed inside it draggable, resizable, rotatable or sortable with mouse, touch or keyboard: multi-select and lasso, sortable lists and grids, smart guides, z-order, drop zones with previews, layout snapshots, undo and saving to attributes.

property.caption: Content
property.description: The widgets that are moved when the user drags.

property.caption: Axis
property.description: Which direction the content can be moved in. 'None' still fires the events but does not move the content.

property.caption: Handle selector
property.description: CSS selector of the element inside the content that starts a drag, e.g. '.drag-handle'. Leave empty to drag from anywhere.

property.caption: Cancel selector
property.description: CSS selector of elements inside the content that must NOT start a drag, e.g. 'input, button'.

property.caption: Disabled
property.description: When true the content cannot be dragged.

property.caption: Touch long-press (ms)
property.description: On touch screens a drag only starts after the finger rests this long on the item, so swiping over it still scrolls the page. 0 starts dragging immediately (and the page cannot be scrolled from the item), as in earlier versions. 250 to 400 works well on phones.

property.caption: Vibrate on long-press
property.description: Gives a short vibration when a long-press starts a drag, on devices and browsers that support it.

property.caption: Bounds
property.description: Restricts how far the content can be moved.

property.caption: Bounds selector
property.description: CSS selector of the element the content must stay inside, e.g. '#canvas'.

property.caption: Max left (px)
property.description: How far the content may move to the left of its start position.

property.caption: Max up (px)
property.description: How far the content may move up from its start position.

property.caption: Max right (px)
property.description: How far the content may move to the right of its start position.

property.caption: Max down (px)
property.description: How far the content may move down from its start position.

property.caption: Grid width (px)
property.description: Horizontal step the content snaps to while dragging. 0 disables snapping.

property.caption: Grid height (px)
property.description: Vertical step the content snaps to while dragging. 0 disables snapping.

property.caption: Resizable
property.description: Adds resize handles on the right edge, the bottom edge and the bottom-right corner (and Alt + arrow keys when the widget has focus). The content's position does not change while resizing.

property.caption: Width attribute
property.description: Optional Integer, Long or Decimal attribute that stores the width in pixels. Written when a resize ends; changing it moves the size.

property.caption: Height attribute
property.description: Optional Integer, Long or Decimal attribute that stores the height in pixels.

property.caption: Minimum width (px)
property.description: Smallest width a user can resize to.

property.caption: Minimum height (px)
property.description: Smallest height a user can resize to.

property.caption: Maximum width (px)
property.description: Largest width a user can resize to; 0 means no maximum (the bounds element still limits it).

property.caption: Maximum height (px)
property.description: Largest height a user can resize to; 0 means no maximum (the bounds element still limits it).

property.caption: Keep aspect ratio
property.description: Resizing keeps the width to height ratio the content had when the resize started.

property.caption: Rotatable
property.description: Adds a rotate handle above the item (hold Shift to turn in steps) and the keys [ and ] (Shift + [ or ] turns 1 degree).

property.caption: Rotation attribute
property.description: Optional Integer, Long or Decimal attribute that stores the rotation in degrees (-180 to 180). Written when a rotation ends; changing it turns the item.

property.caption: Rotation step (degrees)
property.description: Step used while Shift is held on the rotate handle and for the [ and ] keys.

property.caption: Z-order
property.description: Lets the user bring the item forward or send it back among the draggables of its group: Ctrl+] forward, Ctrl+[ backward, Ctrl+Shift+] to the front, Ctrl+Shift+[ to the back, or the item menu. A pointer press does not change the order.

property.caption: Z-index attribute
property.description: Optional Integer or Long attribute that stores the stacking order (1 is the bottom). Written for every item of the group whose layer changes.

property.caption: X attribute
property.description: Attribute that holds the horizontal offset in pixels. Written when a drag ends; changing it from a microflow or nanoflow moves the content.

property.caption: Y attribute
property.description: Attribute that holds the vertical offset in pixels. Written when a drag ends; changing it from a microflow or nanoflow moves the content.

property.caption: Default X (px)
property.description: Starting horizontal offset, used when no X attribute is set or the attribute is empty.

property.caption: Default Y (px)
property.description: Starting vertical offset, used when no Y attribute is set or the attribute is empty.

property.caption: Remember in browser (key)
property.description: Optional key under which the position is saved in the browser's local storage, for pages without X and Y attributes. Use a unique text per widget, e.g. 'dashboard-notes' or 'note-' + toString($currentObject/Id). Bound attributes always win over the saved value.

property.caption: Width
property.description: 'Fit content' lets the element hug its content so it can move sideways inside its parent. 'Full width' stretches it like a normal container.

property.caption: Show position badge
property.description: Shows a small badge with the current X and Y offset while the content is being dragged.

property.caption: Lift while dragging
property.description: Raises the content with a shadow and slight scale while it is being dragged, and eases it back on drop.

property.caption: Raise list rows
property.description: Inside a list view, template grid or gallery: lifts the item's row above the other rows while it is dragged or rests away from its place, so it is never hidden or clipped. Not used in sortable mode.

property.caption: Animate
property.description: Tilts the content slightly in the drag direction, glides between grid steps, plays a ripple on the drop zone and animates returns and throws. Always off for users who ask the system for reduced motion.

property.caption: Motion
property.description: Full: tilt, glides, springs, ripples and zone flashes. Subtle: glides and springs only (no tilt, ripple or flash). Off: no animation. Only applies while Animate is on; always off for users who ask the system for reduced motion.

property.caption: Momentum
property.description: Lets the user throw the content: after a quick release it keeps gliding and slows down, staying inside the bounds and landing on the grid. Needs Animate.

property.caption: Drop zone selector
property.description: CSS selector of the elements the content can be dropped on, e.g. '.drop-zone'. Zones under the pointer get the class 'mxt-drop-zone--over' while dragging. Leave empty to turn drop zones off.

property.caption: Zone id class prefix
property.description: How the zone id is found when the zone has no data-drop-id attribute: a class starting with this prefix gives the id, so class 'drop-zone zone-backlog' gives 'backlog'. After that the id attribute and the 'mx-name-' class are tried.

property.caption: Return if not dropped
property.description: When the content is released outside every drop zone it slides back to where the drag started. Without drop zones it always returns, like a rubber band.

property.caption: Drag type
property.description: Optional type of this item, for example 'task' or $currentObject/Kind. A zone with accept classes (accept-task accept-bug) or a data-accept attribute (space or comma separated types, '*' for all) only takes items of those types; the other zones are marked 'mxt-drop-zone--rejected' while dragging and ignore the drop. Zones without data-accept take everything.

property.caption: Drop preview
property.description: While dragging, shows a ghost outline where the item will really land (after grid snapping, snap guides, overlap avoidance and Return if not dropped), and marks a zone that does not accept the item with 'mxt-drop-zone--invalid' while the item is over it.

property.caption: Snap to siblings
property.description: While dragging, shows alignment guides and snaps to the edges and centres of other draggables in the same container, and to the bounds element when Bounds is 'Parent element' or 'Custom selector'.

property.caption: Snap distance (px)
property.description: How close an edge or centre must come to another one before it snaps.

property.caption: Equal spacing hints
property.description: Also snaps to equal gaps: when the item is in a row or column with other draggables it snaps to a gap that already exists there, or to the middle between its two neighbours, and shows the gaps with their size in pixels. Needs Snap to siblings.

property.caption: Overlap with other draggables
property.description: None: items may overlap. Revert: a drop that would overlap another draggable in the same container returns to where the drag started. Nudge: the item moves to the nearest free spot (grid steps when a grid is set), or returns when there is none.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Nudge to the nearest free spot

property.caption: Auto-scroll
property.description: Scrolls the page (or the nearest scrollable container) while the pointer is held near its edge during a drag, faster closer to the edge.

property.caption: Keyboard dragging
property.description: Makes the widget focusable. Arrow keys move it one grid step (Shift moves ten), Enter or Space picks it up and drops it on the drop zone underneath, Escape cancels.

property.caption: Keyboard step (px)
property.description: Distance one arrow key press moves the content when no grid is set.

property.caption: Undo with Ctrl+Z
property.description: While the widget has focus, Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z) moves it back to its previous position, up to 20 steps.

property.caption: Reset with Home or double-click
property.description: Home (while focused) or a double-click moves the content back to Default X and Default Y.

property.caption: Screen reader instructions
property.description: Read by screen readers when the widget gets keyboard focus.

translations.translation: Draggable. Use the arrow keys to move, hold Shift to move faster. Press Enter or Space to pick up and drop, Escape to cancel.

property.caption: Item menu
property.description: Right-click (or Shift+F10 / the Menu key while focused) opens a menu with the actions this item supports: z-order, rotation, moving in a sortable list, selection, undo, reset and layout snapshots. Every drag action then also has a single-click alternative.

property.caption: Multi-select
property.description: Shift+click or Ctrl+click adds items of the same group to the selection, dragging a selected item moves the whole selection, and the arrow keys move all selected items. Ctrl+Space toggles the focused item, Ctrl+A selects the whole group, Escape clears the selection.

property.caption: Lasso selection
property.description: Dragging with the mouse on the empty background of the lasso area draws a selection rectangle; Shift or Ctrl adds to the selection. A plain click on the background clears it. Needs Multi-select.

property.caption: Lasso area selector
property.description: CSS selector of the container the lasso works in, e.g. '.canvas' (the nearest matching ancestor is used). Empty: the bounds element when Bounds is 'Parent element' or 'Custom selector', otherwise the element that contains the widget.

property.caption: Group
property.description: Draggables with the same group name work together: selection and lasso, group moves, z-order, one shared undo history and layout snapshots. Empty means the group 'default'.

property.caption: Selected attribute
property.description: Optional Boolean attribute set to true while this item is selected.

property.caption: Sortable
property.description: Turns the item into an entry of a sortable list: dragging (or Space, the arrow keys and Space again) moves it to another position while the other items make room. Put the widget inside each item of a list view or gallery. Positions are not stored in X and Y in this mode.

property.caption: List selector
property.description: CSS selector of the list the items are sorted in, e.g. '.mx-name-tasks' (the nearest matching ancestor). Empty: the nearest list view, template grid or gallery, else the parent element.

property.caption: Move between lists
property.description: Items can also be moved to every other list matching the list selector (also empty ones); PageUp and PageDown move a lifted item to the previous or next list. Needs a list selector.

property.caption: Order attribute
property.description: Optional Integer, Long or Decimal attribute that receives the item's new position after a reorder. Every item whose position changed is written. Sort the list on this attribute and refresh it (for example in On reorder) to keep the order.

property.caption: First position
property.description: Value written to the order attribute for the first position, e.g. 0 or 1.

property.caption: Confirm within (ms)
property.description: After On reorder the new order stays on screen until the list shows it. If the list has not changed within this time (and the action has finished), the order is rolled back and a message with Retry is shown. 0 keeps the new order on screen without checking.

property.caption: Layout snapshots
property.description: This item takes part in named layout snapshots of its group (position, size, rotation and z-index). Snapshots are saved and restored from the item menu or the Layout command attribute, and restoring can be undone with Ctrl+Z.

property.caption: Item key
property.description: Unique key of this item inside its group, e.g. 'notes' or toString($currentObject/Id). Empty: the Remember in browser key, then the widget name.

property.caption: Snapshot attribute
property.description: Optional String attribute (unlimited length) that stores the group's snapshots as JSON. Set it on one item of the group, typically bound to a layout object. Without it the snapshots are kept in the browser.

property.caption: Layout command attribute
property.description: Optional String attribute a button can set to 'save Name', 'restore Name', 'delete Name' or 'reset'. The item runs the command for its group and clears the attribute.

property.caption: Reset to snapshot
property.description: Name of a snapshot used by Home, double-click and Reset position instead of Default X and Y, when it contains this item.

property.caption: Picked up
property.description: Announced when the item is picked up with Enter or Space.

translations.translation: Picked up. Move with the arrow keys, press Enter or Space to put down, Escape to cancel.

property.caption: Picked up (drop zones)
property.description: Announced when the item is picked up while drop zones are configured.

translations.translation: Picked up. Move with the arrow keys, press Enter or Space to drop, Escape to cancel.

property.caption: Moved
property.description: Announced after a keyboard move; [x] and [y] are the new offsets.

property.caption: Over a zone
property.description: Announced when the item is over a drop zone; [zone] is the zone id.

property.caption: Dropped on a zone
property.description: Announced after a drop on a zone; [zone] is the zone id.

property.caption: Put down
property.description: Announced after putting the item down outside a zone; [x] and [y] are the offsets.

property.caption: Cancelled
property.description: Announced when a pick-up is cancelled.

property.caption: Edge reached
property.description: Announced when the item cannot move further.

property.caption: Resized
property.description: Announced after a resize; [width] and [height] are the new size.

property.caption: Undone
property.description: Announced after Ctrl+Z; [x] and [y] are the restored offsets.

property.caption: Reset
property.description: Announced after Home or a double-click.

property.caption: Nudged
property.description: Announced when a drop would overlap another item and the item was moved to a free spot.

translations.translation: Moved to the nearest free spot.

property.caption: Reverted
property.description: Announced when a drop would overlap another item and the item went back.

translations.translation: That spot is taken. Back at the start.

property.caption: Zone does not accept
property.description: Announced when the item is over a zone that does not accept it; [zone] is the zone id.

property.caption: Selection count
property.description: Announced when the selection changes; [count] is the number of selected items.

property.caption: Selection cleared
property.description: Announced when the selection is cleared.

property.caption: Selected state
property.description: Read with the item's description while it is selected.

property.caption: Group moved
property.description: Announced after the arrow keys moved several selected items; [count] is the number of items.

property.caption: Lifted (sortable)
property.description: Announced when a sortable item is lifted; [index] and [count] are its position and the number of positions.

translations.translation: Lifted. Position [index] of [count]. Use the arrow keys to move, Space to drop, Escape to cancel.

property.caption: Moved (sortable)
property.description: Announced while a lifted item moves; [index] and [count] are the new position and the number of positions.

property.caption: Moved to another list
property.description: Announced when a lifted item moves to another list; [list] is the list id.

property.caption: Dropped (sortable)
property.description: Announced after a sortable item is dropped.

property.caption: Reorder cancelled
property.description: Announced when a reorder is cancelled; [index] is the original position.

property.caption: Sortable instructions
property.description: Read by screen readers when a sortable item gets focus (instead of the general instructions).

translations.translation: Sortable item. Press Space to lift it, the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it and Escape to cancel.

property.caption: Rotated
property.description: Announced after a rotation; [angle] is the new rotation in degrees.

property.caption: Layer changed
property.description: Announced after a z-order change; [layer] is the new layer (1 is the bottom) and [count] the number of layers.

property.caption: Snapshot saved
property.description: Announced after a layout snapshot is saved; [name] is its name.

property.caption: Snapshot restored
property.description: Announced after a layout snapshot is restored; [name] is its name.

property.caption: Snapshot missing
property.description: Announced when a snapshot to restore does not exist; [name] is its name.

property.caption: Save failed
property.description: Shown and announced when a change could not be written (for example a read-only attribute) and was undone.

translations.translation: This change could not be saved, so it was undone.

property.caption: Reorder not saved
property.description: Shown and announced when the list did not show the new order in time and the order was rolled back.

translations.translation: The new order was not saved, so it was undone.

property.caption: Retry button
property.description: Button that tries a failed change again.

property.caption: Dismiss button
property.description: Button that closes a message.

property.caption: Error message
property.description: Shown instead of the item when it fails to render.

translations.translation: This item could not be shown.

property.caption: Try again button
property.description: Button that renders a failed item again.

property.caption: Saving
property.description: Read by screen readers while an action of the item is running.

property.caption: Menu label
property.description: Accessible name of the item menu.

property.caption: Bring to front
property.description: Item menu entry.

property.caption: Bring forward
property.description: Item menu entry.

property.caption: Send backward
property.description: Item menu entry.

property.caption: Send to back
property.description: Item menu entry.

property.caption: Rotate left
property.description: Item menu entry; turns by the rotation step.

property.caption: Rotate right
property.description: Item menu entry; turns by the rotation step.

property.caption: Reset rotation
property.description: Item menu entry.

property.caption: Move up
property.description: Item menu entry for sortable items (one position earlier).

property.caption: Move down
property.description: Item menu entry for sortable items (one position later).

property.caption: Move to start
property.description: Item menu entry for sortable items.

property.caption: Move to end
property.description: Item menu entry for sortable items.

property.caption: Save snapshot
property.description: Item menu entry that saves the group's layout under a new name.

property.caption: Restore snapshot
property.description: Item menu entry per saved snapshot; [name] is its name.

property.caption: Select all
property.description: Item menu entry (multi-select).

property.caption: Clear selection
property.description: Item menu entry (multi-select).

property.caption: Undo
property.description: Item menu entry.

property.caption: Reset position
property.description: Item menu entry (reset to the default position or the reset snapshot).

property.caption: On drag start
property.description: Runs when the user starts dragging.

property.caption: On drag stop
property.description: Runs after the user releases the content. The X and Y attributes are already updated when this runs.

property.caption: On drop
property.description: Runs when the content is dropped on a drop zone, after On drag stop. Variables: targetId (the zone id), x and y (the content's top-left corner relative to the zone, in pixels).

property.caption: On position change
property.description: Runs after every committed move (drag, keyboard, nudge, undo, reset) with the final translate as variables x and y, for pages where the position cannot be stored in attributes (for example inside a list).

property.caption: On resize
property.description: Runs when a resize ends, with the new size as variables width and height. The width and height attributes are already updated.

property.caption: On selection change
property.description: Runs on every item whose selected state changed (multi-select), after the Selected attribute is written. Variable: count, the number of selected items in the group.

property.caption: On reorder
property.description: Runs on the moved item after a sortable drop, after the order attributes are written. Variables: oldIndex and newIndex (0-based), containerId (the list it was dropped in) and fromContainerId (the list it came from). Commit and refresh the list here; the new order is rolled back if the list does not show it within 'Confirm within'.

property.caption: On rotate
property.description: Runs when a rotation ends, after the rotation attribute is written. Variable: angle in degrees.

property.caption: On z-order change
property.description: Runs on every item whose layer changed, after its z-index attribute is written. Variable: z, the new layer (1 is the bottom).

property.caption: On snapshot
property.description: Runs on the item that saved, restored or deleted a layout snapshot. Variables: operation ('save', 'restore', 'delete' or 'reset'), name, and json (all snapshots of the group, the same text as the snapshot attribute) so a microflow can store it elsewhere.
